correctness.rationale: Derives the exact leaf-count transition, mean and variance using conditional expectation/variance induction. Regression is affine in L_t and the future branches are conditionally independent, yielding the exact covariance. Monotone co-adapted coupling proves pairwise positive association. Bounded martingale-difference representation with predictable bracket converging to the cubic kernel proves a bivariate Gaussian by martingale CLT, including singular endpoint; the Gaussian orthant identity yields the test probability. Independent exact rational enumeration exhaustively checks all recursive trees through eight vertices and all bivariate leaf-count laws for n<=16; 16932 finite assertions passed. Infinite statements are analytically proved, not inferred from enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural and commonly used graph invariant, unrooted leaf count, measures shared ancestry in two uniformly grown networks. The exact strict independence boundary at shared sizes two and three contrasts with graph-level shared-history information, and the finite positive-dependence theorem characterizes all increasing leaf-count tests. The parameter-free cubic correlation scaling and explicit Gaussian above-mean joint probability quantify a meaningful macroscopic detection signal; this is more than a routine marginal moment computation or numeric fit.
